question: Does changed observation normalization or changed actor weights explain quiet-continuation recovery regression?
decision: Prepare two component interventions per parent: parent weights with continued observation normalization; continued actor/mean weights with parent normalization. Action normalization must match exactly. All non-policy learner state stays from the parent; do not train or promote these diagnostic hybrids. Subsequent frozen evaluations at1/5second launches,7postlaunch seconds, bothsigns/backends and8poses:256new cases. Compare against sealed parent and continued-quiet endpoints with exactly matched starts. Check prequalification as well as physical recovery; a hybrid failing pre-hit standing cannot establish a recovery-only effect.
